number: 第二百四十八条の四の三十五
summary_ja: マージン・アグリーメントを締結した取引相手方との取引では、法的有効性等の要件を満たす場合に限り担保の効果を認識でき、将来エクスポージャーの算出上の要件及び最低マージン期間を定める。
summary_en: For counterparties with margin agreements, collateral effects may be recognized only if enforceability and related requirements are met; the article sets requirements for computing future exposure and minimum margin periods of risk.
paragraphs: In transactions with a counterparty with which a margin agreement has been concluded, the effect of collateral received may be recognized only where all of the following requirements are satisfied. (i) That the standards listed in Article 51, item (xii) are satisfied. (ii) That all documents used in collateralized transactions are binding on all parties involved in the transactions and make it possible to enforce them in all relevant jurisdictions. (iii) That the requirement listed in the preceding item is derived on the basis of sufficient legal research and legal reasoning, and that enforceability is confirmed in a timely manner to be continuously maintained.

In calculating future exposure for a counterparty with which a margin agreement has been concluded, all of the following requirements shall be satisfied. (i) The effect of collateral recognized as a risk mitigation technique shall be taken into account along the paths in future exposure. (ii) The nature of the margin agreement, the frequency of collateral calls, the type of collateral, thresholds, independent amounts, initial margin, minimum transfer amounts and all other relevant contractual features shall be appropriately taken into account in the exposure measurement model. (iii) It shall be assumed that no collateral is exchanged with the counterparty within a certain period immediately before the time at which the exposure is measured. In this case, the number of days in that period shall not be less than the minimum period specified in (a) or (b) below according to the category of margin period of risk listed there. (a) For the margin period of risk relating to repo-style transactions, margin transactions and similar overseas transactions, and trade exposures to indirect clearing participants: 4 + N business days (N being based on the interval of collateral exchange specified in the collateral agreement, and being one where daily or intraday exchange of collateral is specified; the same applies in (b)). (b) For margin periods of risk other than the margin period of risk listed in (a): 9 + N business days.
